ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark-grey) to high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity pixels in the central and axial regions; high-intensity white mottling concentrated on the distal margins and tips of both lobes, with a larger, more contiguous white patch on the outer-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 75 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge; the left lobe displays more jagged, irregular pixel variations compared to the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge, curving upward toward the tips; the distal ends exhibit a sharp convex transition at the points of barnacle colonization.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct yellowish-brown high-contrast clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; secondary small circular white spots visible against the dark pigmentation of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned light-grey linear streaks detected on the mid-section of the right lobe lobe, crossing the primary dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue growth and discoloration (tan/yellowish texture) at the terminal points of both fluke lobes, consistent with external parasitic colonization or heavy scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: The combination of the deep V-notch and the dense, textured brownish-yellow accumulation at the lobe tips creates a highly unique silhouette and color profile.
